title: QCommand

QCommand (+Macro/Keybind)
Save and run commands in a simple way
body:
QCommand (+Macro/Keybind)

QCommand is a client-side Minecraft Forge mod that adds quick command buttons to the chat screen. It lets players save one or more commands behind small clickable buttons, choose an icon for each button, assign optional keybinds, and quickly run repeated commands without retyping them.

![QCommand button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fb8e757af03fdfb4ee361856b8c3507cfd1a5dd.png)

![QCommand config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f04c7aeaf0c1330caff0864b468e2cba831b130a.png)

![QCommand examples](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c960e86efbed0c63dd92417ff3a4560b647fd288.png)

![QCommand macro](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1847a5def86e23ef5fcd60a765477aa731403c81.png)

![QCommand icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8559c7df56447439c63143191ee047473165c597.png)

The mod is designed for players who frequently use commands, server utilities, testing commands, admin tools, teleport commands, gamemode switches, or custom datapack/plugin commands.

Main features:

•Adds quick command buttons directly to the chat screen.

•Lets you create, edit, delete, and store custom command entries.

•Supports multiple command lines per saved button.

•Executes saved commands quickly from the chat UI.

•Allows choosing custom visual icons from items, effects, or particles.

•Supports optional keybinds for saved commands.

•Includes command autocomplete while editing command fields.

•Supports repeat behavior while holding a command button.

•Stores commands locally on the client.

•Does not require the server to install the mod.



Example uses:

•Save /home, /spawn, /warp, or /back.

•Save admin commands like /gamemode creative, /time set day, or /weather clear.

•Save testing commands for modpacks, datapacks, maps, or servers.

•Group several related commands into one command entry.

•Use icons to visually recognize each command quickly.

In short: QCommand makes Minecraft command usage faster by turning repeated commands into customizable chat-screen buttons.
